title.narrative: Our Tonle Sap

description.narrative: Our Tonle Sap is a 4-year action implemented by a consortium lead by WCS and also comprising the several co-applicants (RECOFTC, NatureLife Cambodia, SHE enterprises, Oxfam, CDPO, ForumCiv) and Sansom Mlup Prey Organization as an affiliated entity. These partners will help build resilience to ongoing environmental change in ecosystems, communities and biodiversity in the TSBR, via a multi-scaled, integrated landscape approach. The overall objective is: Resilient ecosystems, communities, and biodiversity are able to withstand rapid environmental change in the Tonle Sap Biosphere Reserve. The approach simultaneously addresses the drivers of environmental change at landscape scale whilst developing scalable working models of best practice with government, communities and the private sector at the local scale. We have defined two complementary specific objectives to contribute to achieving the overall objective: (1) Enhance management and restoration of critical habitats to facilitate resilience to environmental change; and (2) Improve governance and policy to reduce drivers of environmental change.
